system.description: A yellowed bone die from the gaming tables of the Unseen Deanery, every face worn smooth but one. Once per day, after you roll a d20 test, turn the die over: the result becomes 21 minus the roll. The new number is not a natural 1 or 20. Expendable d20.
system.lastRite: ◇ After anyone makes a d20 roll, before its outcome is known, set it to any number you choose. A 20 set this way counts as a natural 20.
system.drawback: Your luck is owed. Once, at a moment of their choosing, the Dark Master turns one of your d20 rolls over the same way.
